run_score_singlechain: run the script to score variant sequences against a single chain backbone from a PDB structure
run_score_multichain: run the script to score variant sequences using all chain backbones from a protein complex
run_score_native_sequence: run the script to compute log likelihood and perplexity of a native sequence from a structure file
run_score_fasta_variants: run the script to score all sequences from a FASTA file against a given protein structure
run_score_no_gpu: run the script with the nogpu flag to score sequences on CPU instead of GPU
